title: Convert labels to stable ASCII slugs

requirements.statement: Users can turn a label into a stable ASCII slug or receive a visible error.

acceptance.statement: Normalize case, combining accents and separators; preserve digits and existing slugs.
Reject empty or punctuation-only labels and invalid CLI argument counts with a nonzero exit.

sources.reference: Requested a small new sample application for the workflow pilot.

decisions.summary: Dependency-free Node CLI with explicit ASCII-only slug semantics.

tasks.summary: Implement normalization and CLI error reporting with tests.

tests.summary: Unit and CLI tests cover normalization, idempotence and rejection.
